narrative_engine.thesis: trend up context (H4 stack up · D1 stack up · EMA spread 1.88 ATR · price holds above Day VWAP) set the LONG bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 3.639-3.688 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 3.601; the first objective pays 1.17R at 3.713.

plan.triggerRule: footprint abs fired buy in long direction at the zone
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 3.601 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 A/A+ demoted: no positive-delta absorption or CVD divergence at the pullback zone

athena_oracle.verdict: Neutral equilibrium 52/100 — trend aligned, squeeze fuel overhead, whales offering
